description.value: Cactus Club Cafe at Coquitlam Centre is a polished, chef-driven casual dining chain set inside the Coquitlam Centre shopping complex in the Tri-Cities area. The menu spans modern international dishes—sushi, steaks, pastas, bowls, and shareables—served in a lounge-forward space with a patio and private dining rooms. It opened in January 2023 and offers a convenient full-service meal stop for cyclists passing through the Barnet Highway corridor.
